Camps, Clinics and Tournaments - Women's Soccer

 
Northeastern Women's Soccer ID Clinics provide a unique camp experience while introducing participants to Division I training through technical sessions, tactical drills and goalkeeper instruction. Clinics are open to any and all individuals at all skill levels between the ages of 13 and 18.
